experiments.description: Long videos: music bed ~4 dB lower and nearly silent under speech (renderer/timeline/build.py QUIET_*)

prompt.on: Hook rule for this video: the first beat's `say` voices exactly the stakes frame 0 shows (the hook question in the same words, or the hook figure's placeholder) within its first 8 words. Never open with a warm-up phrase ('Quick question', 'Let's talk about', 'Did you know', 'Today', 'So').

experiments.description: Shorts: the first spoken words say what frame 0 shows; no warm-up opener

prompt.on: Title rule for this video: the title names who and the everyday moment the viewer has lived ('Shopkeeper says UPI above ₹2,000 costs extra?', 'Rich vs Poor: your ₹20,000 raise', 'The dealer says $650 a month'), never an abstract claim about money ('Your emergency fund is quietly losing buying power'). Keep the usual title length and at most one emoji.

experiments.description: Shorts: titles name who and the everyday moment (a shopkeeper, a payslip, a dealer's offer), not an abstract claim about money
Long videos: a two-line chart shades the gap between the lines as it draws and pops a chip naming the gap's figure (remotion/src/scenes/data.tsx ChartScene, `gap`)
